QUOTE: When `hasSearch` is true it renders `<NavigationSearch {...searchProps} hideHeader theme topStyle ref={ref} />` at around line 128.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says NavigationHeader is a forwardRef that passes the ref to NavigationSearch only when `hasSearch` is true. That leaves the ref unattached otherwise, which the answer's table also shows with most callers not setting `hasSearch`.
